0.text: Just like that paranoid bastard to send a babysitter… Alright, well, you may as well make yourself useful.  There’s an Order weapon’s shipment not too far from here - on it’s way to The Bay of Two Souls.

1.text: We’re to disguise ourselves as bandits and take it for all it's worth.  I was looking forward to smashing a few of them Order skulls together.

2.text: Ah bugger it! I’ve twisted my ankle.....

3.text: Look, go on ahead, I’ll catch up in a bit. Take the potion before you go, it’ll change your color and keep them Order bastards from recognizing you.

4.text: Hurry the caravan is already on it's way!
